edges: The Hornets were defeated by the 76ers in the First Round of the 2003 playoffs.
The Hornets lost to the Heat in the First Round of the 2004 playoffs.
The Hornets unexpectedly fired head coach Paul Silas.
The Hornets replaced Paul Silas with Tim Floyd as head coach.
The Hornets began the 2003-04 season strong but finished with a 41-41 record.
The Hornets opened their inaugural season against the original NBA franchise, the Jazz.
